method: Random sample (seed 20261118) of 20 of the 31 (story, object name) candidate pairs written by neo_measure.py: an MPC NEA.txt object name of 4+ letters found as a word in a CNEOS-hosted news story. Each pair was checked by reading the story text around every mention (context dumped with NEO_SNIPPETS, not committed because stories credit people) against the MPC record (number, orbit type) and, where given, the number, size and close-approach date in the story. Verdict: does the mention refer to that near-Earth asteroid.
declared_joins_note: The declared MPC-designation joins need no hand-check; as a sanity check neo_measure.json records absolute-magnitude agreement on every matched pair (joins.*.H_agreement).
